races.name: Crownborn
races.summary: Poised and luminous, Crownborn carry high presence and a steadier hand for refined or arcane play.
races.affinity: Best for composed pressure, ritual focus, and command presence.
races.lore: Crownborn lineages were raised around old courts and radiant halls where posture mattered as much as steel. They still move like every decision is being witnessed.

races.name: Hearthkin
races.summary: Sturdy and reliable, Hearthkin are built to endure pressure and keep the rest of the line standing.
races.affinity: Best for shielding allies, long marches, and defensive support.
races.lore: Hearthkin settlements survived by making every outpost feel like a defended home. Their operators learned to absorb hardship first so others could keep moving.

races.name: Gloamwhisper
races.summary: Quiet and perceptive, Gloamwhispers turn Focus into magical control and precise shifts through uncertain times.
races.affinity: Best for shadowed routes, flexible skirmishing, and subtle reads.
races.lore: Gloamwhisper circles train by listening before acting. Their operators read tension in the dark, then shift shape around whatever the frontier tries next.

races.name: Roadsinger
races.summary: Mobile and fortunate, Roadsingers thrive on discovery, motion, and sudden opportunity.
races.affinity: Best for scouting, route discovery, and opportunistic momentum.
races.lore: Roadsingers cross borders like they were written into the path itself. Their lineages trust chance, motion, and the promise that every road still has one more door to open.
